actionTimingAndMovement.contract: issuedAction is the accepted transition into the current observation
actionTimingAndMovement.rejectedMovementFinding: Rejected primary move is retried; if alternate also fails no frame is stored. Dataset has no rejected stored frame. U05/U06 would otherwise ignore actionAccepted.

imageActionPairing.finding: Image is captured after accepted action; replay advances that action and processes the same current image; RESET is first observation.

actorLeakage.finding: No label, pose, target coordinate, score, or oracle direction enters observe during replay.
actorLeakage.limitation: Topology checkpoint is not live-integrated; no live behavior claim.
